findings.explanation: The fire-linked gray cast over Illya’s death tableau disappears.

findings.highlight: I don’t want a child dying in front of me
findings.evidenceJa: 子供が死ぬのはイヤだ
findings.governingReading: I cannot bear a child dying
findings.explanation: The English imports “in front of me” from the next, separate proposition.

findings.evidenceJa: 無関係な涙を流している
findings.governingReading: why are these eyes shedding tears for someone unrelated to me
findings.explanation: Shirou’s estrangement from his own grief and insistence that Illya is unrelated disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 士郎は自分があるじゃない
findings.governingReading: but you possess a self, Shirou
findings.explanation: Rin’s central claim that Shirou has a definite self disappears.

findings.highlight: You can’t pretend you are not living for yourself
findings.evidenceJa: 自分をないがしろにするなんて出来ない
findings.governingReading: you cannot continue neglecting your own self
findings.explanation: Self-neglect becomes alleged dishonesty about Shirou’s motives.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺の行く末が報われない
findings.governingReading: the road ahead of me will never be rewarded
findings.explanation: A tragic, futile outcome becomes lack of gratitude from others.

findings.evidenceJa: 人の死は見慣れたもの
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses the causal conjunction and noun.

findings.highlight: You saw something gruesome ten years ago
findings.evidenceJa: それだけのモノを、十年前に見た
findings.governingReading: you saw death on that scale ten years ago
findings.explanation: Rin’s inference about magnitude is replaced with generic gore.
Comparison to the fire’s inhuman devastation becomes a claim about natural causes.

findings.highlight: the main reason why Tohsaka is criticising me
findings.governingReading: a factor for which Tohsaka could blame me
findings.explanation: The English invents a hierarchy by calling the fire the main reason.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分自身が訴えている
findings.explanation: Shirou’s self-knowledge is reassigned specifically to his body.

findings.highlight: I do not have any regrets
findings.governingReading: there was no repentance along that path
findings.explanation: The same stylized path statement is again flattened into ordinary regret.

findings.highlight: My self lost its self there
findings.evidenceJa: 我はそこで自身をなくした
findings.governingReading: there I lost my very self
findings.explanation: The repeated line again becomes malformed reflexive English.
A missing space fuses Shirou’s recovering interjection.

findings.governingReading: there at the brink, I thought
findings.explanation: The near-death abyss framing Shirou’s revelation disappears.

findings.highlight: the first thing that came into my sight
findings.explanation: The English invents priority and turns Kiritsugu’s image into an unspecified thing.

findings.highlight: Sothat’s all the emotion I could create
findings.evidenceJa: だから俺は、そんな感情しか作れなかった
findings.governingReading: and so that was the only emotion I could create
findings.explanation: A missing space breaks the conclusion of Shirou’s self-diagnosis.
